title: Time Since Resolution: Share Charged on a Delivery Claims Found Parcel
content:
Recovery terms for Delivery Claims: the share of a found-parcel charge that is taken depends on how long ago the claim was resolved.

**Term.** The recovery share depends on how long ago the claim was resolved: 60 or more calendar days before today charges 50% of the courtesy-reduced base, 30 to 59 calendar days charges 75%, and fewer than 30 days charges all of it.

Days: calendar days from the claim's resolution date to today.

| Days since the claim was resolved | Share charged |
|---|---|
| 0 to 29 | 100% — all of it |
| 30 to 59 | 75% |
| 60 or more | 50% |

## Edges (hypothetical resolution on 1 March)

| Today | Days since resolution | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 30 March | 29 | 100% |
| 31 March | 30 | 75% |
| 29 April | 59 | 75% |
| 30 April | 60 | 50% |

*Hypothetical:* on a courtesy-reduced base of 80.00 USD, a claim resolved 45 days ago is charged 75%, that is 60.00 USD, on this term.
